annotations.text:
The problem: openProcedure() dumped every JSON field as prose, so a 21-step procedure arrived as one wall of text with the exclusions and the reporting rules buried at the bottom.

All of this is real PROC-MNV content. Nothing is invented.

Read the marker sheet first (bottom right), then the flow (left). The index is how you arrive.

Every marker: glyph + word + colour. Never colour alone.
The one refusal: the content orders decision points but does not pin them to a step number, so the diamonds keep their own track rather than being placed on the spine at a position nobody authored.
